build_llamalike_transformer: build a Llama-like transformer model with configurable heads, dtypes, and MLP variants using LlamalikeTransformerConfig
test_build_and_run_gemma: test building and running a Llama-like transformer with full, mixed, multi-query, grouped-query, and Gemma2-style attention configurations
test_build_and_run_sampling_mode: test building a KV-caching transformer sampler and running temperature-based autoregressive decoding with a pyloop
test_build_and_run_layer_stack: test building a transformer with use_layer_stack enabled and verifying KV cache metadata and per-layer cache shapes
test_attention_types: test sliding window causal and global causal attention types with post-attention and post-FFW normalization in a Llama-like transformer
